_notes: Thorn Tithe: the vines growing. One painted 2x2 sheet (thorn_tithe_growth.png, 1254x1254, cells 627x627) of one clump at four moments: three shoots, five vines, full height, the closed cage with a bead of sap. Emerald-teal vines with pale thorns on a #00FF00 green screen, keyed on hue with keyed: "green-soft" (the teal would shift under the min(r,b) clamp). Every cell shares one ground line, so content_crop takes one crop for all four and the base stays put as the clump grows.
